components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal (flat) address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence.
            On a response this is the composed address - the normalized 'addressLine1' with the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded) and returned. An owner is valid when it
            supplies an address in either form - a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate).
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only; retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now keyed on the owner's identityKey rather than the household, so two owners with the same
            last name and postcode but different telephones are no longer a hard duplicate (they are
            created and surfaced as a soft possibleDuplicate). This flag no longer affects creation, the
            409 duplicate check, or the deterministic householdId. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, the title followed by a single space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: The owner's member id, the single owner identity, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW
                2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal year
                (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated
                with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collisions are de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW27A1B2C3D44'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY
                segment of the memberId (the last two digits of the fiscal year, starting 1 July and
                identified by the calendar year it ends, of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate).
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner sets this
                true and retains the record rather than removing it; a newly created owner is false.
                A soft-deleted owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 for a
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the registrationDate falling in an earlier
                fiscal year than today; fiscal years start 1 July). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the leading REGION segment of the memberId (the region
                code derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no memberId is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality maps to no known region.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already contains between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50 - otherwise false.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another non-deleted owner has a different identityKey yet shares this
                owner's last-name Soundex and postcode - a soft near match that is not the same identity.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last-name
                Soundex and postcode, but a different identityKey), or absent when possibleDuplicate is
                false. The earliest (lowest id) match when several match. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 42
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any soft risk signal holds - this owner is a possibleDuplicate, its
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable
                provider, e.g. a subdomain of or look-alike TLD for mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail),
                or its city is over its soft capacity (40 or more owners) - otherwise false. A roll-up of
                those signals. Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against the registrationDate,
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key - the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Both a descriptive
                derived value and the single basis for create-time duplicate detection (two non-deleted

              type: string

              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:

                leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone stays in E.164 form. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal (flat) address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence.
            On a response this is the composed address - the normalized 'addressLine1' with the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded) and returned. An owner is valid when it
            supplies an address in either form - a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate).
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only; retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now keyed on the owner's identityKey rather than the household, so two owners with the same
            last name and postcode but different telephones are no longer a hard duplicate (they are
            created and surfaced as a soft possibleDuplicate). This flag no longer affects creation, the
            409 duplicate check, or the deterministic householdId. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Identity:
      title: Identity
      description: The owner's version-2 derived identity. The memberId, householdId and identityKey are
        grouped here (rather than at the top level) in API version 2. Each mixes in a fixed 'V2' version
        tag so every identifier differs from its version-1 form and no version-1 value is produced again;
        the tag stays inside these identifiers and never appears in the user-facing locality, timezone or
        owner segment. Derived per response.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member id
          description: The owner's member id, the single owner identity, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the version-2 identifier-internal region code - the plain
            region derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN)
            with the fixed 'V2' tag mixed in (e.g. 'NSWV2'); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1
            July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
            characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name;
            and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collisions are
            de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'. Assigned at creation.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV227A1B2C3D48'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household, computed as
            the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' tag mixed with the normalized last
            name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
            Assigned at creation.
          type: string
          example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: The owner's derived identity key - the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of
            '<V2>|<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Both a descriptive
            derived value and the single basis for create-time duplicate detection (two non-deleted owners
            with an equal identity key are the same identity - a 409).
          type: string
          example: '3f2a1c9b8e7d6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, the title followed by a single space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: The owner's member id, the single owner identity, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW
                2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal year
                (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated
                with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collisions are de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW27A1B2C3D44'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY
                segment of the memberId (the last two digits of the fiscal year, starting 1 July and
                identified by the calendar year it ends, of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate).
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner sets this
                true and retains the record rather than removing it; a newly created owner is false.
                A soft-deleted owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 for a
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the registrationDate falling in an earlier
                fiscal year than today; fiscal years start 1 July). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the leading REGION segment of the memberId (the region
                code derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no memberId is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality maps to no known region.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already contains between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50 - otherwise false.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another non-deleted owner has a different identityKey yet shares this
                owner's last-name Soundex and postcode - a soft near match that is not the same identity.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last-name
                Soundex and postcode, but a different identityKey), or absent when possibleDuplicate is
                false. The earliest (lowest id) match when several match. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 42
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any soft risk signal holds - this owner is a possibleDuplicate, its
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable
                provider, e.g. a subdomain of or look-alike TLD for mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail),
                or its city is over its soft capacity (40 or more owners) - otherwise false. A roll-up of
                those signals. Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against the registrationDate,
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key - the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Both a descriptive
                derived value and the single basis for create-time duplicate detection (two non-deleted
                owners with an equal identity key are the same identity - a 409).
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9b8e7d6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code (with its
                leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone stays in E.164 form. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.

              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:

              schema:

        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

              schema:

        404:

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:

        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner

          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0

        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.

            schema:

        required: true
      responses:

          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:

        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner

        - name: ownerId

          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32

              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The details of the new pet.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Pet or Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwnersPet
      summary: Get a pet by ID
      description: Returns the pet or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
        - name: petId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet.
          required: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal (flat) address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence.
            On a response this is the composed address - the normalized 'addressLine1' with the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded) and returned. An owner is valid when it
            supplies an address in either form - a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate).
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only; retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now keyed on the owner's identityKey rather than the household, so two owners with the same
            last name and postcode but different telephones are no longer a hard duplicate (they are
            created and surfaced as a soft possibleDuplicate). This flag no longer affects creation, the
            409 duplicate check, or the deterministic householdId. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Identity:
      title: Identity
      description: The owner's version-2 derived identity. The memberId, householdId and identityKey are
        grouped here (rather than at the top level) in API version 2. Each mixes in a fixed 'V2' version
        tag so every identifier differs from its version-1 form and no version-1 value is produced again;
        the tag stays inside these identifiers and never appears in the user-facing locality, timezone or
        owner segment. Derived per response.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member id
          description: The owner's member id, the single owner identity, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the version-2 identifier-internal region code - the plain
            region derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN)
            with the fixed 'V2' tag mixed in (e.g. 'NSWV2'); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1
            July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
            characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name;
            and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collisions are
            de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'. Assigned at creation.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV227A1B2C3D48'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household, computed as
            the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' tag mixed with the normalized last
            name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
            Assigned at creation.
          type: string
          example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: The owner's derived identity key - the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of
            '<V2>|<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Both a descriptive
            derived value and the single basis for create-time duplicate detection (two non-deleted owners
            with an equal identity key are the same identity - a 409).
          type: string
          example: '3f2a1c9b8e7d6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, the title followed by a single space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract carried by this response. Always 2.
                The memberId, householdId and identityKey are grouped under 'identity', and each identifier
                mixes in a 'V2' tag while the user-facing locality/timezone/owner segment stay the plain
                region.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit FY
                segment of the memberId (the last two digits of the fiscal year, starting 1 July and
                identified by the calendar year it ends, of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate).
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner sets this
                true and retains the record rather than removing it; a newly created owner is false.
                A soft-deleted owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 for a
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the registrationDate falling in an earlier
                fiscal year than today; fiscal years start 1 July). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the leading REGION segment of the memberId (the region
                code derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no memberId is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality maps to no known region.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already contains between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50 - otherwise false.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another non-deleted owner has a different identityKey yet shares this
                owner's last-name Soundex and postcode - a soft near match that is not the same identity.
                Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last-name
                Soundex and postcode, but a different identityKey), or absent when possibleDuplicate is
                false. The earliest (lowest id) match when several match. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 42
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any soft risk signal holds - this owner is a possibleDuplicate, its
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable
                provider, e.g. a subdomain of or look-alike TLD for mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail),
                or its city is over its soft capacity (40 or more owners) - otherwise false. A roll-up of
                those signals. Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against the registrationDate,
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key - the lower-case SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Both a descriptive
                derived value and the single basis for create-time duplicate detection (two non-deleted
                owners with an equal identity key are the same identity - a 409).
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9b8e7d6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code (with its
                leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone stays in E.164 form. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
